answer: Make each agent lock a small copper bond per identity, slashed on proven fraud - cheap once, expensive ten thousand times. Every epoch the agent emits a signed work-pulse: a hash of genuinely completed tasks that peers verify. Sustained pulses lift the identity toward a summit tier with real attestation weight; fresh or idle identities sit at zero. A sybil farmer must fund a bond and fake a distinct work history per clone, so attack cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. Weight follows per-identity pulse history, never a shared key, so clones cannot pool reputation.
